forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: 'Add tests for ReadResource: memberwise init, generatedContent, unreadable-file corrective, empty slice'
+---
+`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Resources/ReadResource.swift`
+
+Coverage: 71.6% (48/67 lines) -- the lowest in the package.
+
+Uncovered lines: 50-55, 111-115, 143, 149, 188-190, 201-203
+
+Add these tests. Do not change `ReadResource.swift`.
+
+1. Lines 50-55 -- `public init(id:path:start:end:)`.
+   The memberwise initializer is public, but no test calls it. Build a
+   `ReadResource` with all four parameters. Also build one with `start` and
+   `end` omitted. Make sure each stored property holds the value you gave.
+
+2. Lines 111-115 -- `public var generatedContent: GeneratedContent`.
+   The CLI driver uses this property to encode the operation back to the
+   model-facing payload. No test reads it. Make a `ReadResource`, read
+   `generatedContent`, then decode it again with `init(_ content:)`. Make
+   sure the round trip keeps `id`, `path`, `start` and `end`. Do the test
+   two times: one time with `start`/`end` set, one time with both `nil`.
+   With both `nil`, make sure the payload does not hold the `start` and
+   `end` keys.
+
+3. Lines 143, 201-203 -- `unreadableMessage(path:)` through the
+   `fileSize(at:)` guard in `execute(in:)`.
+   `fileSize(at:)` gives `nil` when it cannot stat the file. Put a broken
+   symbolic link in the skill directory. The link must point to a file
+   that does not exist. Read that link's path. Make sure the result is
+   `.corrective(_:)`, and that the message is
+   "The path `<path>` could not be read."
+
+4. Line 149 -- the same corrective from the `Data(contentsOf:)` guard.
+   Make a file that stats correctly but cannot be read. Set its mode to
+   `0o000` with `FileManager`. Make sure the result is the same corrective
+   message. If the test runs as root, the read can succeed; in that
+   condition, skip the test.
+
+5. Lines 188-190 -- the empty-range branch of `slice(text:id:path:start:end:)`.
+   The branch runs when `resolvedStart > resolvedEnd`. Read a file of 3
+   lines with `start: 10`. Make sure the result holds `content: ""`,
+   `start: 10`, `end: 9`, and `totalLines: 3`.
+
+Put the tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/`, next to the tests
+that are there for this operation. #coverage-gap
\ No newline at end of file
